title: Loom log
intro: Where each part of this page comes from, what was changed, and what is made up. This file is the source of the Loom log panel; tools/build_page.py adds the scene hashes and counts of the build it writes.

grades.Confirmed: licence text or metadata was read
grades.Likely: licence inferred from the project that made the data, not read
grades.Suspected: no licence file found; kept to derived geometry with attribution

sources.name: Template cortex surfaces: fsaverage pial, sulc, Desikan-Killiany labels
sources.used_for: glass cortex, wet cortex, region anchors and centroids
sources.licence: FreeSurfer lineage; the template bucket carries no licence file
sources.changes: the template's own lower-density pial vertex set (about 41k vertices per hemisphere in the full build, about 10k in the repo build; not decimated by us), moved rigidly (axes reordered, origin shifted, scale 1.000), medial-wall triangles removed, per-vertex ambient occlusion baked into the colour channel, labels reduced to centroids and surface anchors. No raw surface or label file is shipped.
sources.cite: Fischl et al. 1999, Hum Brain Mapp, doi 10.1002/(sici)1097-0193(1999)8:4<272::aid-hbm10>3.0.co;2-4 (DOI checked against the template description file; title and authors not checked: verify)

sources.name: MNI152NLin2009cAsym template: aseg segmentation and T1w
sources.used_for: deep structure meshes (thalamus, caudate, putamen, pallidum, hippocampus, amygdala, accumbens, ventricles, brainstem, cerebellum) and six T1 slices
sources.licence: permissive MNI licence text; the copyright notice is carried in NOTICE-BRAIN-DATA.md
sources.changes: marching cubes on the smoothed label masks and mesh smoothing; the meshes and six windowed 2D resamples of the T1 (alpha from intensity) are scaled and shifted per axis (about 3 to 5 percent) so that their cortex bounding box equals the fsaverage cortex bounding box (a look-level fit, not a registration). No raw volume is shipped.
sources.cite: Fonov et al. 2011, NeuroImage, doi 10.1016/j.neuroimage.2010.07.033; Fonov et al. 2009, NeuroImage 47 (S1), doi 10.1016/S1053-8119(09)70884-5

sources.name: TotalSegmentator example subject s1397 (whole-body CT, 117 segmentations at 3 mm)
sources.used_for: the Torso CT tab: skeleton, lungs, heart, vessels, organs, skin, lung vessels
sources.licence: CC BY 4.0, inferred from the dataset's published terms; the licence record of this copy was not read
sources.changes: masks to signed-distance fields, marching cubes, smoothing, decimation of the CT-derived meshes. Skin and lung vessels are CT thresholds, not segmentations. Changes were made. No raw CT or mask volume is shipped.
sources.cite: Wasserthal et al. 2023, Radiology: Artificial Intelligence, doi 10.1148/ryai.230024

sources.name: X_ITE 16.6.0 (X3D browser in JavaScript)
sources.used_for: drawing the scene, picking, camera, sound
sources.changes: none; the page loads the vendor build unchanged (tools/fetch_xite.sh fetches it)

notices.text: The glowing tract arcs are generated curves between region anchors. They are not tractography of any subject or scan.
Activation blobs are placed sprites, not measured activity. Glow, halos, colours and translucency are artistic choices, not tissue properties.

The MNI deep structures and slices are scaled and shifted per axis to the cortex template's bounding box (the cortex is not scaled). It is a look-level fit, not a registration; positions are not anatomy.

The template brain in the torso is an affine fit into one subject's brain mask: the folds are the template's, not the subject's. The subject has a forward head posture and raised arms, shown as recorded.

Region facts and the tour captions were drafted by a text model, then rewritten and checked against standard neuroanatomy. No expert or clinical review was done and they can still be wrong. Check any clinical use against a primary source.
Look palettes were measured (numbers and hex colours only) from private reference images that are not shipped. The music beds (about 33 s each, loops) were made by a music model.

Not a medical device. Not for diagnosis or treatment. No patient data is used or collected. The page requests only its own files and the X_ITE script (vendored, or from a public CDN when the vendor folder is missing); it sends nothing anywhere.

generated_content.text: Region function, fact, clinical and imaging lines (44 regions) and the eight tour captions: text model, then rewritten and checked (no expert review).
generated_content.images: No generated images are shipped in the repo build. The private build uses reduced thumbnails of private style references as look cards.
generated_content.audio: Music beds: music model, two clips of about 33 s each (one used as the loop); described in NOTICE.md section 7.

receipt.note: The sha256 of runs/brain-20261106/receipt.json, which accepts the two lite scenes under the brain-demo/v1 profile (grammar, meaning, traps, data-true and its controls pass; eyes, behaviour, page-traps and real-gpu are recorded as not run). The receipt does not cover the full-resolution scenes of the private build or this page folder. Receipts are unsigned (Loom law 35).
